dogecoin.text: "The DOGE-1 mission comes after Musk, the self-proclaimed 'Dogefather,' made his debut as host of 'Saturday Night Live.' The price of dogecoin plunged during his appearance, falling below 50 cents, despite his references to the cryptocurrency."

"Musk previously announced the company’s plans, albeit in a tweet on April Fool’s Day.

'SpaceX is going to put a literal Dogecoin on the literal moon,' Musk wrote."
